title: Control Plane Canary v2 — Full Lifecycle Verification
description:
A harmless canary mission to verify the agent control plane v2.0 works end-to-end with all bug fixes.

This mission MUST:
1. Create a timestamped canary file at docs/growth/agent-loop/canary/<timestamp>-v2.md
2. The file must contain: mission ID, worker identity, execution timestamp, repository SHA
3. No application code changes. No deployment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- docs/growth/agent-loop/canary/ directory exists with at least one new .md file
- File contains mission-control-plane-canary-v2
- File contains a valid ISO timestamp
- File contains a valid git SHA
- File contains v2.0 marker
- All content is in English
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/growth/agent-loop/canary/ directory if not exists
Create a timestamped .md file in that directory with -v2 suffix
